QUOTE: `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member #else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member` ... "By default the member is renamed to `private_nr`." ... "The default is for application developers who link against mbedTLS... The opt-out is for the library's own sources and its sample programs." ... "Inside the library, ... their accesses use the real member names."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows both macro branches and says code that defines the opt-out (library sources, sample programs) sees real member names, while ordinary consumers of the public headers see the `private_` names.
